metadata.title: The friction on a quantized vortex in a truncated Gross-Pitaevskii field follows the temperature, not the normal density: a pre-registered test of alpha proportional to rho_n against the cutoff, and the correction of a published reading
metadata.description: The mutual friction alpha on a quantized vortex in a two-dimensional Bose field is commonly taken to scale with the normal fraction rho_n/rho. In an earlier paper (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23225293) we measured alpha(T) in the projected Gross-Pitaevskii equation at one cutoff and found alpha ~ 0.24 rho_n/rho; we read the coefficient as a mode-averaged transport cross-section of the vortex (1.4 healing lengths) and registered its cutoff dependence as the open question, with the Born phonon-scattering law (coefficient proportional to the cutoff) as the rival. Here the same energy-conserving instrument, with its T = 0 known answer reproduced to 0.3 % at each cutoff, is run at two further cutoffs (k_c xi = 2 pi/3 and 2 pi). The registered prediction of a cutoff-independent coefficient fails and so does its rival: the coefficient is 0.31 +- 0.03, 0.232 +- 0.014, 0.096 +- 0.013 at k_c xi = 2.1, 3.1, 6.3. What does not move is alpha itself: alpha/T = 0.054 +- 0.003 over five arms and three cutoffs (chi2 = 1.3 for 4 degrees of freedom). The proportionality to rho_n was a degeneracy of a single cutoff, where rho_n is proportional to T; the 'geometric core size' reading is withdrawn. The temperature law was found after the data were read; it is registered as a hypothesis, with its prediction for the next arm fixed before that arm was read (reported in the paper). Pre-registrations, controls, scripts, analysis file and Lean companion (FrictionKinetic.lean) are in the software record.
metadata.notes: Companion to the vortex-transport paper; corrects its reading of alpha proportional to rho_n (see its version 2.2).
